parameters.query: WITH target_runs AS (SELECT id,document_id,document_version_id FROM legal_ingestion_runs WHERE metadata->>'workflow_id'='Bzi9dHprJPgP54H2' AND status IN ('processing','failed')), target_versions AS (SELECT DISTINCT document_version_id id FROM target_runs WHERE document_version_id IS NOT NULL), emb_del AS (DELETE FROM legal_chunk_embeddings e USING legal_document_chunks c,target_versions v WHERE e.chunk_id=c.id AND c.document_version_id=v.id RETURNING e.id), chunk_del AS (DELETE FROM legal_document_chunks c USING target_versions v WHERE c.document_version_id=v.id RETURNING c.id), ver_del AS (DELETE FROM legal_document_versions v USING target_versions t WHERE v.id=t.id AND v.is_current=false RETURNING v.id), run_del AS (DELETE FROM legal_ingestion_runs r USING target_runs t WHERE r.id=t.id RETURNING r.id,r.document_id), target_docs AS (SELECT DISTINCT document_id id FROM run_del WHERE document_id IS NOT NULL), doc_del AS (DELETE FROM legal_documents d USING target_docs t WHERE d.id=t.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_document_versions v WHERE v.document_id=d.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legal_ingestion_runs r WHERE r.document_id=d.id) RETURNING d.id) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM target_runs) AS target_runs,(SELECT count(*) FROM emb_del) AS deleted_embeddings,(SELECT count(*) FROM chunk_del) AS deleted_chunks,(SELECT count(*) FROM ver_del) AS deleted_versions,(SELECT count(*) FROM run_del) AS deleted_runs,(SELECT count(*) FROM doc_del) AS deleted_documents;
